title: the JITSO rules of brief.md end with three communication lines: find a peer with jitso fleet, SendMessage between Claude Code sessions followed by jitso link, or orca orchestration send otherwise, and reply with orca orchestration reply
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, release 1 of the communication plan; orca orchestration send --help and reply --help (send needs --subject, reply needs --id and --body); release 2 of the communication plan for the jitso link step
intent: Every launched session reads the same short rule on how to reach another session. The text is fixed, the same in direct and fleet mode, and the whole rules section stays under eight lines (heading, three rules, three communication lines). SendMessage leaves no trace JITSO can read, so the sender records the synapse with jitso link; an Orca message needs no link, because jitso graph reads it from the inbox.

contains:
never run `jitso build save`.
Find another session with `jitso fleet` (read only); your own row is the one with your launch id.
Between two Claude Code sessions use `SendMessage` to the session name, then run `jitso link <your launch id> <peer>`; otherwise use `orca orchestration send --to <handle> --from <your handle> --subject <s> --body <b>`.
Put your own handle and session name in every message, so the peer can answer with `orca orchestration reply --id <msg_id> --body <b>`.
